perc_male.long_description: Cooperative extension demographic measures combining ACS data with County Health Rankings data for Virginia. Percent male is from ACS table S0101 (Age and Sex). Children raised by grandparents from ACS table B10001 (Grandchildren Living with a Grandparent Householder), calculated as a percentage of total population (B01001_001). Disconnected youth (ages 16-24 neither in school nor working) and voter turnout (percent of citizens 18+ who voted in the previous presidential election) are from County Health Rankings, which compiles data from the ACS and other federal sources.
perc_male.provenance: Percent male from ACS table S0101 (Age and Sex). Children raised by grandparents from ACS table B10001. Disconnected youth and voter turnout from County Health Rankings, which compiles ACS and other federal data sources.
perc_male.short_description: The percent of males in population.

disconnectedYouth.long_description: Disconnected youth, also referred to as opportunity youth, are teenagers and young adults between the ages of 16 and 24 who are neither in school nor working. Youth who are actively looking for work are considered disconnected. (NOTE: Counties that are missing data do not collected reliable data on subject)
